question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Procure
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"procure"** means to obtain something, especially with effort or care. (प्राप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She managed to **procure **a rare book from the antique shop.
 
 
 
• **"Hinder"** refers to creating difficulties for someone or something, resulting in delay or obstruction. (बाधा डालना)
 
 
• **Example:** The heavy traffic could** hinder** our arrival at the airport on time.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'procure'** is **'hinder'**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Multiply** (गुणा करना): To increase greatly in number or quantity.

 
 
• **Example:** Bacteria can multiply rapidly under favorable conditions.
 
 
 
• **Consume** (उपभोग करना): To use up a resource or eat/drink something.
 
 
• **Example:** Humans consume a large amount of natural resources every day.
 
 
 
• **Abstain** (परहेज करना): To choose not to do or have something.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to abstain from eating sweets during his diet.
